sentences.en: The majority of his income goes to pay his rent.
sentences.zh: 他的大部分收入都用来支付房租。

sentences.en: The majority of Japanese temples are made out of wood.
sentences.zh: 日本大多数寺庙都是用木头建造的。

sentences.en: None of the candidates got a majority of the votes.
sentences.zh: 没有任何候选人的票数超过半数。

senses.zh: 大多数；<英>多数票；成年的法定年龄；多数党；少校军衔，少校职位
